fields.description: The tenant's display name, e.g. Acme Corp. The Suite app sends its workspace name.
fields.label: Title

fields.description: Where tenant-specific notices go, such as downtime or a domain losing verification. Set by the tenant through the API.
fields.label: Contact Email

fields.description: Unchecked, the tenant's secret stops authenticating. Archive clears it and Resume sets it again; Suspend leaves it checked so the tenant gets a 403 naming the suspension instead of a bare 401.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Active serves the API. Suspended keeps the key valid but answers every request with a 403 naming the suspension. Archived is final and required before deletion.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: When the tenant was archived. Set by the Archive action; the tenant cannot be resumed after this.
fields.label: Archived At

fields.description: Sent by the tenant as Authorization: Tenant <id>:<secret>. Stored encrypted and shown once, after Rotate Secret; rotating it invalidates the previous secret immediately.
fields.label: Secret

fields.description: One per line: the IPv4 or IPv6 addresses, or CIDR ranges, the tenant's server sends from. Set, only requests from these addresses may use the tenant's secret; a leaked secret is useless elsewhere. Blank accepts any address.
fields.label: Allowed IP Addresses

fields.description: Requests authenticated with the tenant's secret run as this service user. Taken from Suite Cloud Settings on every save.
fields.label: Service User

fields.description: The Stalwart cluster hosting every mail domain and account of the tenant. Fixed once the tenant exists; the cluster must be active at creation.
fields.label: Cluster

fields.description: Outbound mail of this tenant's domains leaves through this pool instead of the cluster default. A domain may name its own pool. The pool must belong to the tenant's cluster.
fields.label: Egress Pool

fields.description: Mail Domains the tenant may hold. Adding one beyond the limit fails. 0 means unlimited.
fields.label: Max Domains

fields.description: Mail Accounts the tenant may hold across all its domains. Creating one beyond the limit fails. 0 means unlimited.
fields.label: Max Accounts

fields.description: Mail Groups the tenant may hold across all its domains. Creating one beyond the limit fails. 0 means unlimited.
fields.label: Max Groups

fields.description: Mailing Lists the tenant may hold across all its domains. Creating one beyond the limit fails. 0 means unlimited.
fields.label: Max Mailing Lists

fields.description: Disk the tenant's plan includes, in gigabytes, shown to the tenant next to its usage. 0 means unlimited. It does not cap the quotas of its accounts and groups.
fields.label: Total Disk Quota (GB)

fields.description: Disk used by the tenant's accounts and groups together, as the cluster last reported it (kept for 5 minutes); nothing is stored.
fields.label: Used Disk
